test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a meaningful sentence
P: while the committee deliberated on the proposed reforms, Q: numerous stakeholders voiced their concerns R: regarding the potential impacts S: during the public consultation process
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **QSRP**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence logically starts with **Q**, as it introduces the action: "numerous stakeholders voiced their concerns."
 
• Next, **S** follows as it specifies the context: "during the public consultation process."
